bio: Etienne Matous is a shrewd and industrious Facchini who has built modest wealth through careful negotiation and unwavering dedication to his work at the contract stall. Despite his humble origins, he possesses an astute understanding of commerce and harbor politics, though his sharp tongue and tendency toward stubbornness often complicate his relationships with fellow workers and merchants.
